'''Ayahi Takagaki''' (Japanese: '''高垣彩陽''' ''Takagaki Ayahi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Takagaki was born on October 25, 1985 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became an actress as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|DP}} where she voiced [[Kylie]]. She gained her most prominent role in {{aniseries|JN}}, voicing [[Goh]]'s friend and rival [[Horace]].
